messages:
From: Tom Parker <tom.parker@marigold.com>

Cc: Priyanka Gupta <p.gupta@finbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 7 Mar 2025 14:14:00 -0000
Subject: Scheduling demo for pilot week (week of Mar 9)

Hi Marcus,

We're excited to move forward with the pilot next week. One wrinkle: our global team noted the US moves clocks the weekend of Mar 9, but EU doesn't change until later in March. That creates a one-week window where usual overlap times shift by an hour for our US folks. Can you confirm: if we schedule for Mon/Tue (Mar 10/11), will the invite show correct local times for everyone?

Preferably we'd do a single 45-minute walkthrough that works for EU late afternoon and US early morning (so product and infra folks can attend), and a separate 20-minute AM slot for our APAC engineers if needed. If that's hard, we can do a recording + live Q&A.

Attaching our availability grid (see attached). Let me know your recommendation and a couple of concrete slot options.

Thanks,
Tom Parker
Director of Integrations
Marigold Financial
Attachment: marigold_availability_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 8 Mar 2025 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo for pilot week (week of Mar 9)

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the availability file. Good catch on the US "spring-ahead" gap. Short answer: calendar clients will auto-adjust, but the human confusion often comes from ambiguous invite text and ambiguous timezone labels.

Two practical options we use to avoid mis-sync:
- Option A (preferred): One 45-minute live walkthrough timed to hit EU late afternoon and US early morning (we can offer Mon Mar 10 at 16:00 CET / 10:00 EST). Follow with a recorded copy and a 20-minute APAC-focused Q&A the following day (Tue Mar 11 08:00 SGT).
- Option B: Two live, region-targeted sessions: 30 minutes for US/EU overlap (Mon Mar 10 09:45 EST / 15:45 CET) and 20 minutes for APAC later (Tue Mar 11 08:00 SGT).

We recommend Option A to keep momentum and reduce context-switching; Option B if you want separate invite lists.

I'll tentatively hold the two slots in our calendar and attach a .ics with explicit timezone labels. Also attaching our mutual action plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) with suggested attendees per session. Jonas — can you confirm we have availability on Mon Mar 10 15:45-16:30 CET and Tue Mar 11 08:00 SGT? Rachel — can you prep a 5-slide APAC appendix for the recording?

Attachments: proposed_slots.ics; MAP_v2.xlsx

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Marcus — confirmed on our side for the two proposed windows. A couple pragmatic notes from ops: 

1) Use explicit zone strings in the invite title/body (e.g., "Mon Mar 10, 15:45 CET / 09:45 EDT (note: US clocks spring forward Mar 9)"). That reduces client confusion.
2) Create two separate calendar invites (one labeled "Live demo — EU/US overlap" and one labeled "APAC Q&A / recording") rather than changing a single invite time. Some clients' calendars will update the single event and obscure the original time.
3) For APAC, send the recording plus a 20-minute live office-hours block and allow joining anonymously; that lowers barrier for engineers behind strict corp firewalls.

I'll keep the engineer rota short: Jonas (demo lead), Marcus (product), Rachel (APAC appendix + recording intro). 

—Jonas
